verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Asana serves a live llms.txt at developers.asana.com/llms.txt with markdown-append instructions for docs pages, directly enabling agent-native doc consumption, and this sits alongside a full REST API reference, OpenAPI spec repo, and API explorer. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of agents actually using llms.txt in practice, and a discoverable OpenAPI JSON endpoint (probe found 404s on standard paths, mitigated by the GitHub-hosted spec).
